reading the data

```{r }
observational_data <- observational_data <- read.delim("/Users/mandarphatak/Downloads/Tina_Thesis/SPI_RDI_Data/Obseravtaionalfordroughtanalysis.txt", sep = ";") 
observational_data |> head()
```

data cleaning

```{r}
observational_tbl <- observational_data |> 
  rename(date= MESS_DATUM) |> 
  mutate(date=ymd(date)) |>
  dplyr::select(date,RSK,TMK,TNK,TXK,TGK)
observational_tbl <- observational_tbl |> 
    mutate(RSK = ifelse(RSK == -999, NA, RSK)) 
    
## renaming RSK as precipitation (PREC)
observation_tbl <- observational_tbl |> 
  rename(PREC = RSK)
```
```{r}
observation_monthly_tbl <- observation_tbl %>%
        mutate(year = year(date), month = month(date)) %>%
        group_by(year, month) %>%
        summarize(
            PREC = sum(PREC, na.rm = TRUE),  # Total annual precipitation
            Tavg = mean(TMK, na.rm = TRUE),  # Average annual temperature
            Tmax = mean(TXK, na.rm = TRUE),  # Average annual maximum temperature
            Tmin = mean(TNK, na.rm = TRUE),  # Average annual minimum temperature
            .groups = 'drop'
        ) |> 
  mutate(date = make_date(year, month))
observation_monthly_tbl
```

```{r}
observation_annual_tbl
```

```{r}
observation_monthly_tbl <- observation_monthly_tbl |>
mutate(PET = hargreaves(Tmax = Tmax, Tmin = Tmin, Pre = PREC ,lat = 53.6350, na.rm = TRUE))
observation_monthly_tbl <-observation_monthly_tbl |> 
  mutate(BAL = PREC - PET)
```


```{r}
observation_annual_tbl <- observation_monthly_tbl |>
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarize(
        PREC = sum(PREC, na.rm = TRUE),
        BAL = sum(BAL, na.rm = TRUE),
        Tavg = mean(Tavg, na.rm = TRUE),
        PET = sum(PET, na.rm = TRUE),
        Tmin = mean(Tmin, na.rm = TRUE),
        Tmax = mean(Tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = 'drop'
    )
```


## RDI Index
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(zoo)
library(fitdistrplus)
# Function to calculate RDI for given data and scale
calculate_yearly_rdi <- function(data, scale = scale) {
  # Ensure valid input data
  data <- data %>%
    filter(PET > 0, PREC >= 0) %>%
    arrange(year)
  
  # 1. Alpha (α) Calculation with Rolling Aggregation
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(alpha = rollmean(PREC / PET, k = scale, fill = NA, align = "right"))
  
  # 2. Normalized RDI Calculation
  mean_alpha <- mean(data$alpha, na.rm = TRUE)
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(RDIn = (alpha / mean_alpha) - 1)
  
  # 3. Standardized RDI Calculation
  # Select valid alpha values for distribution fitting
  valid_alphas <- data$alpha[!is.na(data$alpha) & is.finite(data$alpha) & data$alpha > 0]
  
  if (length(valid_alphas) > 1) {
    # Fit log-normal distribution
    fit <- fitdist(valid_alphas, "lnorm")
    meanlog <- fit$estimate["meanlog"]
    sdlog <- fit$estimate["sdlog"]
    
    # Transform to standardized RDI
    data <- data %>%
      mutate(
        prob = plnorm(alpha, meanlog = meanlog, sdlog = sdlog),
        RDIst = qnorm(prob)
      )
  } else {
    stop("Not enough valid data to fit the distribution.")
  }
  
  return(data)
}
```


```{r}
rdi_3yr <- calculate_annual_rdi(observation_annual_tbl, 3)
rdi_6yr <- calculate_annual_rdi(observation_annual_tbl, 6)
rdi_9yr <- calculate_annual_rdi(observation_annual_tbl, 9)
rdi_12yr <- calculate_annual_rdi(observation_annual_tbl, 12)

```
### RDI 3
```{r}
rdi_3 <-  rdi_3yr |> 
  filter(year > 1989) |> 
  rename(rdi_3 = rdi) |> 
  select(year, rdi_3) |> 
mutate(sign = ifelse(rdi_3>0,"pos","neg"))
trend_model <- lm(rdi_3 ~ year, data = rdi_3 )
trend_value <- coef(trend_model)[2]  # This is the slope
trend_value_rounded <- round(trend_value, 3)  # Round to 3 decimal places
trend_text <- paste0("Trend: ", trend_value_rounded)

rdi_3 |> 
  ggplot(aes(year, rdi_3)) + 
  geom_col(aes(x = year, y = rdi_3, fill = sign), show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.65) + 
  geom_smooth(aes(x = year, y = rdi_3), color = "red", method = "lm", se = FALSE, size = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("pos" = "darkgreen", "neg" = "#FF8109")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1990, 2023, by = 3), expand = c(0.02,0.02)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = seq(-3, 2.5, by = 0.5),
        sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = NULL, breaks = seq(-3, 2.5, by = 0.5)),
        expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
  labs(
    title = "Hamburg Fuhlsbüttel Reconnaissance Drought Index(RDI-3) 1990-2023",
    x = "", 
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1990, 2023), ylim = c(-3, 2.5)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", size = 0.5)  +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold", colour = "black", size = 30, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    #plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold", colour = "black", size = 25, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", color = "black", size = 25),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", size = 25),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 1),
    panel.background = element_blank(), 
    plot.background = element_blank(),  
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),  
    axis.line.y.right = element_line(color = "black", size = 1),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", size = 25),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", angle = 90),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 50, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20, unit = "pt")
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 2011, y = 2.25, label = trend_text, size = 10, color = "black", hjust = 0, fontface = "bold")

```

## SPEI Indices ###
```{r}


bal_ts <- ts(observation_annual_tbl$BAL, start = 1936, frequency = 1)
# Step 5: Compute SPEI with scales 12,9,6,3
spei_3 <- spei(bal_ts, scale = 3)
spei_6 <- spei(bal_ts, scale = 6)
spei_9 <- spei(bal_ts, scale = 9)
spei_12 <- spei(bal_ts, scale = 12)

# Step 6: Add SPEI results back to the annual data frame

spei_12 <- spei_12$fitted |> as_tibble()
spei_9 <- spei_9$fitted |> as_tibble()
spei_3 <- spei_3$fitted |> as_tibble()
spei_6 <- spei_6$fitted |> as_tibble()


colnames(spei_12) <- "spei_12"
colnames(spei_9) <- "spei_9"
colnames(spei_6) <- "spei_6"
colnames(spei_3) <- "spei_3"
years <- 1936:2023

# View the results
spei_12 <- data.frame(year = years,Value = spei_12)
spei_9 <- data.frame(year = years,Value =spei_9)
spei_6 <- data.frame(year = years,Value = spei_6)
spei_3 <- data.frame(year = years,Value = spei_3)
```

```{r}
  theme_minimal() +  # Added theme_minimal() for a clean base theme
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold", colour = "black", size = 30, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", color = "black", size = 25),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", size = 25),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 1),
    panel.background = element_blank(), 
    plot.background = element_blank(),  
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),  
    axis.line.y.right = element_line(color = "black", size = 1),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", size = 25),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", angle = 90),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 50, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20, unit = "pt")
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 2011, y = 1.65, label = trend_text, size = 10, color = "black", hjust = 0, fontface = "bold")

```
### SPEI 12 
```{r}
spei_12 <- spei_12 |> filter(year > 1989)
spei_12 <- spei_12 |> mutate(sign = ifelse(spei_12 >=0, "pos","neg"))
trend_model <- lm(spei_12 ~ year, data = spei_12 )
trend_value <- coef(trend_model)[2]  # This is the slope
trend_value_rounded <- round(trend_value, 3)  # Round to 3 decimal places
trend_text <- paste0("Trend: ", trend_value_rounded)
spei_12$spei_12 |> min()
```
